title: What is the Price of a Soil Sensor?
content: The price of a soil sensor ranges from BDT 40,000 to 80,000, depending on the model and features.

title: What Parameters Does a Soil Sensor Indicate?
content: A soil sensor can measure key soil parameters including Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), Potassium (K), moisture, temperature, pH, and salinity to help farmers monitor soil health.

title: How Long Does It Take to Determine Soil Components Using a Soil Sensor?
content: Using a soil sensor, it typically takes 10 to 15 minutes to determine the soil components and obtain readings for all key parameters.

title: What is the Accuracy of Soil Sensor Tests?
content: The accuracy of soil sensor tests ranges from 80% to 95%, depending on the sensor model and testing conditions.
